idea-plugin.name: Custom Vue Component Explorer
idea-plugin.description:
Displays a live list of the custom Vue components of the current project.

  • Scans every .vue single file component and detects its declared name.
  • Detects globally registered components and custom web elements.
  • Counts how many times each component is used inside templates.
  • Navigate to the declaration or copy the tag name directly from the list.

action.description: Shows the custom Vue components of the file that is currently open
